verses.he: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, But unto Thy name give glory, For Thy mercy, and for Thy truth's sake.
Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is now their God?'
But our God is in the heavens; Whatsoever pleased Him He hath done.

verses.he: עֲ‍ֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

verses.he: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.he: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃
verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

verses.he: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם׀ וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃
verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they with their throat. .

verses.he: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

verses.he: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust ye in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

verses.he: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.en: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

verses.he: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.en: The LORD hath been mindful of us, He will bless— He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless them that fear the LORD, Both small and great.
The LORD increase you more and more, You and your children.

verses.he: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Blessed be ye of the LORD Who made heaven and earth.

verses.he: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD; But the earth hath He given to the children of men.

verses.he: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל־יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃
verses.en: The dead praise not the LORD, Neither any that go down into silence;

verses.he: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ׀ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.
